about: Dan K. Webb is an attorney who represents clients in the Chicago, Illinois area. Dan Webb is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dan Webb chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Loyola University Chicago School of Law and graduated in 1970. Dan Webb passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1970.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Illinois. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar and Antitrust Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dan Webb has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
